Package io.webagent4j.core

package io.webagent4j.core
WebAgent4J's public facade: the entry point application code starts from.

WebAgent.browser() is the only way to obtain a BrowserBuilder, which discovers a concrete IBrowserProvider at runtime through ServiceLoader - this module never depends on webagent4j-browser-playwright (or any other backend) at compile time, so it stays backend-neutral by construction rather than by convention.

Everything reachable from the resulting IBrowser - pages, frames, locators, observations, actions, verification, and extraction - is defined in webagent4j-browser-api and its domain modules; this package owns only the launch step. See docs/public-api.md for the full map of modules and entry points.
